classes.description: Zolpidem IR/ER/SL (Ambien, Ambien CR, Edluar), eszopiclone (Lunesta), zaleplon; ramelteon (Rozerem) and low-dose doxepin (Silenor) may be listed as alternatives.

classes.name: Orexin receptor antagonists
classes.description: Dual orexin receptor antagonists: suvorexant (Belsomra), lemborexant (Dayvigo), daridorexant (Quviviq).

classes.name: Benzodiazepines and buspirone for anxiety

classes.plainDescription: A medicine for anxiety or panic attacks.
